sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection 
checklist I2, which must be every six months as indicated by M6 in 
the title block .

The exciter data 2.42 MVA, 525 Vac, Y 
connection, 
2420 A , PF=0.5 , 50HZ, 3000 RPM

The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Aziz El 
Bagoury, tested by eng. Enas Azmy and revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Saad 
Bassuony accepted by eng. Aly Abdel Whab general director and approved by eng. 
Fathy Ragab head sector of Talkha PS

This document 
accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil EDEPC inspection quality control general 
director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant: Mahmoud Soliman: EDEPC 
admin. & financial inspection and quality control general director, and supervisor 
of inspection quality control head sector.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety 
 healthy, safety shoes, gloves pairs, 
 breathing mask, safety glass etc .
The unit must be out of service .

العمل المراد تنفيذه

Check 
 for correct operation of exciter room air condition and ventilation fan.

Before and after cleaning slip ring of exciter 
 measure the insulation resistance between slip ring and earth by using megger 
 device 500 Vdc approximately ≥ 3 MΩ table (1) to be sure the results of 
 cleaning.
Check interconnection terminals.

Remove thyristor units clean it and measure 
 its insulation resistance by using megger device 500 Vdc approximately ≥ 1 M 
 Ω .
Change polarity of alternator (Q6).

Check push buttons, signal lamps, fuses, 
 and auxiliary relay.

Check signals of warning, limitation 1st , 
 limitation 2nd , and shut down at control room and JVP panel (open circuit 
 test).

Check operation of regulator, start stop 
 logic, phase control, diagnostic, RG3 and RG4.

Clean the insulators of output of exciter 
 Y, 3ph, 525 Vac.
